# Parano1d v2.0.1

**Mandatory v2 patch. Update before mainnet block 210,537.**

This release replaces v2.0.0 for the scheduled v2 activation. Update nodes, GUI wallets, block-producing pool nodes and exchange infrastructure before H210537. The activation height is unchanged. v2.0.0 continues to follow the existing chain before that height, so users who have already installed it can update in place. No data reset or wallet migration is needed. Genesis, balances and wallet secrets are unchanged.

## Difficulty at the v2 boundary

A candidate block's own timestamp currently affects its ASERT target. Competing blocks with the same parent can therefore carry different work solely because their timestamps differ. From H210537, the target is derived from the parent header and the canonical ASERT anchor. Siblings with the same parent have the same target regardless of their own timestamps. Blocks through H210536 retain their original difficulty rule. Chain selection still uses accumulated work, followed by the deterministic hash tie-break when work is equal.

## Contract indexing

`getMempoolEntry` now returns the admitted public opening of a pending contract call in `contract_opening_hex`. `getBlockDetails` marks retained contract transitions as `call` or `close`. These read-only fields help indexers capture terms while a call is pending and identify calls in retained blocks. The public opening is already broadcast with the call intent; this release does not change what the network reveals.

The v2 proof matrices and contract rules are unchanged. The transition packages continue to include both historical and v2 verification material.
